input.explanation:
Fault: `average_spend_per_item_this_month` divides the month-to-date total by the number of purchases made in the current month without checking that count. Any account that has not bought anything yet this month (a large, steadily growing share of page views early in a billing month) gives `len(bought) == 0`, so the integer division raises ZeroDivisionError and the account page 500s. Turning on `monthly-spend-feature` only made that code path reachable; the fault was the unguarded division.

Fix: guard the empty case and return 0 cents per item, which is the correct answer for "no items bought this month". The division is now only reached when there is at least one purchase. I also completed `Account.__init__`, which silently dropped `total_cents` and `total_this_month_cents`, so the summary function could not read the totals it depends on (an AttributeError waiting behind the same flag).

Tests: the previously empty test file now covers the shopper who did buy (average is computed correctly, floor division), the shopper with no purchases this month (returns 0, the case that was crashing), the account with no purchases at all, and that purchases from earlier months are excluded from the divisor. This makes the flag safe to turn back on.

files.content:
from io_shop.accounts import Account
from io_shop.spend_summary import average_spend_per_item_this_month


class Purchase:
    def __init__(self, cents, in_current_month):
        self.cents = cents
        self.in_current_month = in_current_month


def test_the_monthly_average_is_correct_for_a_shopper_who_did_buy():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(1000, True), Purchase(500, True)],
        total_cents=1500,
        total_this_month_cents=1500,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 750


def test_the_monthly_average_is_zero_for_a_shopper_who_bought_nothing_this_month():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(1000, False)],
        total_cents=1000,
        total_this_month_cents=0,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 0


def test_the_monthly_average_is_zero_for_an_account_with_no_purchases_at_all():
    account = Account(purchases=[], total_cents=0, total_this_month_cents=0)

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 0


def test_purchases_from_earlier_months_are_not_counted_in_the_divisor():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(900, False), Purchase(900, False), Purchase(300, True)],
        total_cents=2100,
        total_this_month_cents=300,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 300


def test_the_average_floors_to_whole_cents():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(100, True), Purchase(100, True), Purchase(101, True)],
        total_cents=301,
        total_this_month_cents=301,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 100

input.summary: Return 0 instead of dividing by zero when an account has no purchases in the current month
